_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil base rate (3% of 12h windows move ±2+) makes HOLD the skilled call; Disbelief is the natural next rung if the score drifts up, but no breaker is visible to justify a directional bet.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both place current phase at Denial, but analyst explicitly flags the analog as misleading while Narrative leans on it; analyst calls HOLD direction with medium conviction, Narrative implies potential squeeze without committing to direction.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND stablecoin growth turns positive — genuine risk-on continuation toward Hope
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX sustains above 75 with BTC breaking $60k forcing Anxiety/Panic retest, or ETF flows turn negative with funding dropping below 35 confirming distribution
